# SVNR Global

> SVNR Global builds bespoke AI-powered client acquisition systems and outreach infrastructure for premium operators — luxury brands, private equity and family offices, premium real estate, wealth management, and high-ticket B2B. We replace dependence on ads, referrals, and trade fairs with a permanent acquisition engine that identifies, reaches, and warms the exact decision-makers in a client's market.

Founded in 2019 by Hamza Omair. Headquartered in New Delhi, India; deployed globally across Europe, the UK, North America, the Gulf (GCC), and Southeast Asia. Engagements are bespoke and limited to a small number of clients at a time; there are no shared templates or recycled sequences.

## What SVNR Global is
- A B2B client acquisition agency and outreach infrastructure firm — not a lead-list vendor and not a volume cold-email agency.
- Delivers warm, qualified conversations with decision-makers, not raw leads or impressions.
- Combines deep sector research, AI-enriched prospect data (50+ signals), and hyper-personalised multi-channel outreach (email, LinkedIn, WhatsApp).
- Typical time to first qualified conversations: 14–21 days from deployment.
- Most clients see 40+ qualified conversations per month by month two.
- Average reply rate: 18% across sectors (industry average for cold email: 2–5%).
- Pricing: bespoke per engagement; no retainer contracts and no shared infrastructure.
- Not a marketing agency. Does not run ads, produce content, or manage social media.

## Services
- [Client Acquisition](https://svnrglobal.com/services/client-acquisition/): End-to-end acquisition infrastructure — ICP definition, prospect research, individually crafted messaging, multi-channel deployment, warm handoff.
- [AI Receptionist](https://svnrglobal.com/services/ai-receptionist/): Trained AI front desk that qualifies, responds to, and routes every inbound enquiry in under 60 seconds, 24/7.
- [Intelligence Research](https://svnrglobal.com/services/intelligence-research/): AI prospect intelligence and market mapping across 50+ data sources — company filings, LinkedIn, business press, property records, funding signals.
- [Brand Outreach](https://svnrglobal.com/services/brand-outreach/): Researched, individually written outreach for premium and luxury markets. 18–24% reply rates.
- [Revenue Operations](https://svnrglobal.com/services/revenue-operations/): Full-funnel pipeline tracking and automation built around the client's deal cycle.
- [Sector Workflows](https://svnrglobal.com/services/sector-workflows/): Operational AI automation built for a specific vertical. Deployed in 1–4 weeks.
- [Deal Flow & Investor Relations](https://svnrglobal.com/services/dealflow-investor/): Proprietary deal flow and LP acquisition for private equity and family offices. Founder outreach before formal sale processes begin.
- [Channel Partnership](https://svnrglobal.com/services/channel-partnership/): Systematic activation of distributors, resellers, showrooms, and trade partners. 10–20 partners per market in 90 days.

## Industries served
- [Luxury Rugs & Home Textiles](https://svnrglobal.com/sectors/luxury-rugs-home-textiles/): A&D community outreach and trade buyer acquisition. 13 qualified enquiries in 14 days without trade fairs.
- [Premium Real Estate](https://svnrglobal.com/sectors/premium-real-estate/): HNW investor and principal buyer acquisition without portal dependency. First contact in 14 minutes in one recent programme.
- [Private Equity & Family Offices](https://svnrglobal.com/sectors/private-equity-family-offices/): Proprietary deal flow infrastructure and LP fundraising support.
- [B2B Luxury Brands](https://svnrglobal.com/sectors/b2b-luxury-brands/): Stockist and trade buyer acquisition. 78% enquiry lift in six weeks.
- [Wealth Management](https://svnrglobal.com/sectors/wealth-management/): UHNW and HNW client acquisition through trigger signal monitoring and discreet personalised outreach.
- [High-Ticket E-commerce](https://svnrglobal.com/sectors/high-ticket-ecommerce/): Wholesale and trade buyer acquisition. 312% average order value increase via trade channel.
- [Maritime & Logistics](https://svnrglobal.com/sectors/maritime-logistics/): Cargo owner and charterer acquisition. Tender intelligence and logistics decision-maker outreach.
- [Professional Services](https://svnrglobal.com/sectors/professional-services/): Client acquisition for law firms, consultancies, and architecture studios. Positions the firm as peer, not vendor.

## Founder
Hamza Omair — Founder & CEO. Background in luxury rug and carpet manufacturing and international trade (Bhadohi, India) and a degree in computer applications.
